en.text: Dose, timing, and use context materially change how melatonin labels should be read, which is why similar-looking products can still be serving different shopper needs.
Dose-response meta-analysis and insomnia reviews support treating melatonin as a timing-sensitive ingredient rather than as a single generic sleep category.
Check the stated milligrams and whether the label frames sleep-onset, circadian, or broader routine support before assuming two melatonin products are equivalent.
Do not treat a higher dose or broader sleep headline as automatic proof that one melatonin product is universally better.
